name: KAIST College of Business (KAIST MBA)

program.note: KAIST MBA (full-time, launched 2023, Seoul campus, 'Global Business Analytics' track). 2-year length taken from the school scholarship page ('Full/partial tuition for 2 years', https://www.business.kaist.edu/admission/0302). KAIST also runs a full-time Impact MBA and Finance MBA, not collected here.

tuition_total.cohort: KAIST graduate cost table, 2023 academic year
tuition_total.note: Official KAIST international graduate cost table ('Cost of Studying at KAIST, 2023 academic year') gives tuition KRW 19,118,000 (annual budget, all graduate programs, not MBA-specific). Total = 2 x 19,118,000 computed by us. Table is dated 2023; no MBA-specific fee page found.

mandatory_fees_total.note: No separate mandatory fees listed; Student Health Insurance Association KRW 83,000 and health insurance premium KRW 1,726,080 appear in the living budget.

living_budget_total.note: 'Subtotal, except for the tuition' KRW 11,070,787; total with tuition 30,188,787. Annual basis presumed (table not explicit). Generic KAIST graduate budget, dated 2023.

scholarship.type: KAIST Scholarship for international applicants: full/partial tuition for 2 years; living stipend KRW 500,000/month to selected students; GPA >= 3.3/4.3 to keep it
scholarship.note: Amount and number of recipients vary each year. The 94% scholarship rate on the admissions cost page concerns KAIST international graduate students overall (research programs), not the MBA.

employment.note: No MBA employment report or salary published on business.kaist.edu (English site checked: program, Facts & Figures, Global Achievements, Talented People pages) nor found by search on 2026-10-13. Korean-language site/brochures not checked in depth.

profile.note: No class profile on the KAIST MBA page (student profile tabs exist only for Professional/Executive MBA).

notes: Thin data: cost only (generic 2023 graduate table). School site cites QS and FT Executive Education Open rankings, no FT Global MBA 2026 rank. Candidate for removal from the 75-school list or for a cost-only card.
